panels.prompt: {{style}}. {{notext}}. Comic book cover, heroic low-angle shot inside {{vault}}. Exactly three kids stand shoulder to shoulder at the bottom, looking up with awed smiles, left to right: {{theo}}; {{dev}}; {{zara}}. Above their heads floats {{vex}}, glowing. Behind them towers {{ring}}, every cyan dot lit bright. The top quarter is plain dark stone, empty.
panels.alt: Andre, Mateo and Layla stand together at the bottom of a tall stone vault lit by brass lanterns, smiling up at a giant round stone dial whose cyan lights all glow, while VEX, the small teal robot with one golden eye, floats above them.
